name: Droplet Border
description: A button with a droplet of light that runs round its border at a steady pace.

props.name: children
props.description: The label, with an optional icon. Icons are sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, for example "a" for a link. Props for that element are passed through.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the droplet to go once round.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Outer corner radius in pixels. The path of the droplet and the inner surface follow it.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the droplet. At night its head is lightened toward white.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the inner surface that holds the label.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer element, which is the button itself.
